name: Image Operations
description: Masks, resampling, crop, quarter turns and rotation by any angle with the straighten crop, blur, tone adjustments and histograms (levels, curves and histograms on linear or sRGB-encoded values) and cloning from an offset through a mask over PixelBuffer. W1/ declares the values the W1 engines share (AffineMatrix, ColorLUT, LayerEffect and the tone, matte, fill and gradient values), with no operations. Masks/ holds mask feathering, contours and mattes read from a buffer. Tone/ holds the color-family tone ops and the auto-tone suggestion. Effects/ holds the layer effects a PixelBuffer applies. Affine/ holds transforms through an AffineMatrix, flips and canvas padding. Fill/ holds flood fill by tolerance and raster gradient fills. Heal/ holds healing from sampled source pixels. Hash/ holds PerceptualHash, a 64-bit DCT hash of a buffer: resampled to 32 x 32 with the bilinear filter (which averages areas when shrinking), Rec. 709 luminance of the premultiplied values, so alpha composites over black, sRGB-encoded, a 2-D DCT-II, and one bit per coefficient (u, v) in 1...8 (the DC row and column dropped) set when it is above their median; distance is the popcount of the XOR, and the same buffer gives the same bits on every platform. It also holds DuplicateGroups, which puts ids whose hashes chain within a distance (clamped to 0...10, negative groups nothing, since past 10 random hashes start to chain) into groups of two or more, each id in one group, each group sorted by id and the list by first id, through a multi-index table over four 16-bit blocks and a union-find, near-linear in the number of hashes.
